statements.statement: CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring was ordered
Patient presenting with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
Raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
Personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
Study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events (G45.9)
Study was ordered to guide anticoagulation management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The documented indication directly supports the medical necessity of this monitoring study
